title: RatKing Orodruin Bars
content:
Heat treating increases yield strength and fatigue life. The Orodruin bars can take a bigger beating before permanent deformation and can withstand more stress cycles than normalized 4130 for an extended lifespan. They will maintain the comfortable ride feel of steel, but they will hold up to gnarlier crashes before deforming. Hammer out of the saddle and huck to flat with confidence. No crossbar keeps these bars feeling supple and  your wrists will thank you.

Oroduin Bars Quick Hits

  • 22.2 Clamp – 875mm width / 265mm control grip length
  • heat treated 4130
    • oil quenched + tempered
  • Passed ISO 4210-5 §4.9.1.2 mountain bike in phase fatigue test.
  • 13.5 degree sweep
  • 3 degree upsweep
  • 50mm rise
  • These numbers move around based on bar rotation (stated at an 80 degree angle)
  • powdercoated glossy clear

Get yours today at Ratking Frames.
